title: Package Reduction Where a Resort Lodging Household Also Skis and Hires
content:
A household that has booked its lessons and hired its kit with the collective for the same season as its Resort Lodging stay has a package reduction taken on the room rate. Two kinds of holding are read: the household's school bookings under the Snowsports School, and its rental agreements under Equipment Rental and Demo, each read for its standing and for the season it is held for.

Where the household holds both a school booking standing confirmed and a rental agreement standing confirmed for the season of the stay, the package reduction of 5 percent is taken.

Where the household holds either a school booking standing confirmed or a rental agreement standing confirmed for that season but not both, the half package reduction of 2.5 percent is taken.

Where the household holds neither for that season, no package reduction is taken.

| School booking standing confirmed for the season | Rental agreement standing confirmed for the season | Reduction taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 5 percent |
| yes | no | 2.5 percent |
| no | yes | 2.5 percent |
| no | no | none |

### Reading the two holdings (hypothetical households)

A household with two children enrolled in a group lesson standing confirmed for the season of the stay, and a season's junior kit on a rental agreement standing confirmed for that same season, holds both, and the package reduction of 5 percent is taken.

A household with the same lesson enrolment but whose only rental agreement was closed at the end of the previous season holds one of the two for the season of the stay, and the half package reduction of 2.5 percent is taken.

A household that hires its kit from outside the collective and books no lessons holds neither, and no package reduction is taken.
